# Fixtures / Golden invariants

Do not commit extracted Wuthering Waves assets here.

After P0, record only non-copyright-sensitive validation metadata for the selected golden character, for example:

- source Unreal object path
- game build/version
- LOD count
- mesh section count
- vertex/index counts
- bone count
- material slot count
- morph target count
- texture dependency count
- hashes of locally generated staging outputs where useful

Synthetic/self-authored fixtures may be committed for CI.
